name: ConformanceTestPlan
title: Conformance Test Plan
publisher: The Committee for Doing It Properly
description: How to test whether a system exchanges health data The Right Way. Execution of this plan is optional, like most test plans.
testTools: Any FHIR validator, a fax machine for regression testing, and patience.
exitCriteria: All tests pass, or the release date arrives, whichever is first.

testRun.narrative: Read the example patient and validate it against the Kitchen Sink Patient profile.

concept.text: No errors, or errors with documented excuses

dependency.description: Requires a patient to have been read successfully.

testRun.narrative: Invoke $generate-excuse for REQ-2 and check that the excuse is in the accepted list.
